escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Publish a valid terminal handoff and then add a material regression test or workflow change without regenerating the certificate and evidence.

literal_case.procedure: Compare the certified material head with the immutable PR commit chain after every post-freeze write and require a fresh terminal child.
literal_case.expected: Any material write after freeze invalidates the old handoff and forces post-write refreeze before audit.
literal_case.observed: The current material candidate is refrozen at the final material commit; all refreshed evidence is bound to that same candidate before terminal publication.
literal_case.evidence: Immutable Git history, exact-head CI runs, local current-base merge check, and regenerated handoff artifacts.

sibling_cases.evidence: Post-write classifier requires refreeze when a test path changes after the certified material head.
